title: [finding] `sys_approval_request.payload_json`'s doc comment claims notifications render from the snapshot — measured false against all 12 notify call sites
body:
Found while implementing #10749 (read-time redaction of the approval payload snapshot), during the consumer inventory the ruling made step 1.

## Observation

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` documents the column as:

> `payload_json` captures a snapshot of the target record at submission time — **used by notifications so they can render before the record is locked or changed.**

Measured against every `this.notify(...)` call site in `approval-service.ts` — **12 of them**: routed-to-you, routed-to-delegate, auto-rejected, sent-back, handed-to-you, two reminder shapes, more-info-requested, new-comment, escalated-to-you, SLA-breached, submitter-SLA. Every one passes a payload of `{ title, message, actionUrl }` (two also carry `actions` with action-link URLs). **None of them reads `payload` or `payload_json`.** The messages are built from `raw.object_name` / `raw.record_id` and the caller's comment text.

So the stated consumer does not exist. This matters beyond tidiness: the sentence is the only documented justification for the column holding a *full* row, and it was cited as such during the #10749 inventory before being checked.

## Why this is filed rather than fixed

The string is **extracted into the generated i18n bundles** (`translations/*.objects.generated.ts`), so rewording it is a translation-regeneration change (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, four locales), not a comment edit. The same file already carries a precedent for exactly this constraint on its `organization_id` description, where the correction was deliberately made to ride a related fix rather than land as a drive-by.

The accurate replacement is roughly "snapshot of the target record at submission time, retained as audit evidence of what was submitted and served (redacted per reader, #10749) to the approvals inbox" — but the exact wording should be settled by whoever owns the regeneration pass.

## Locator

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` — the module docstring above `SysApprovalRequest`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.objects.generated.ts` — the extracted copies.

## Notes

- Observation only — no runtime behaviour is wrong, and nothing is currently misled by it except the next reader of the column.
- No assignee — recording, not claiming. Not queued.
